art_direction_summary: A quiet premium editorial gallery for Temply Studio: warm ivory surfaces, soft amethyst and lilac accents, restrained desk objects, generous whitespace, and source-faithful planner pages presented as a polished digital download.

concept_board.hero: A softly lit tablet on a warm ivory desk, with the exact January 2027 calendar page as the visual anchor and subtle amethyst paper accents.
concept_board.palette: Warm ivory, pale blush-lilac, muted amethyst, soft gray, brushed brass, charcoal typography.
concept_board.mockup: Clean tablet and paper mockups with blank screens generated by Image Generation; exact PDF pages are inserted locally into the blank display areas.
concept_board.gallery_rhythm: Hero, orientation, toolkit, monthly, daily, wellness, weekly, navigation, extras, and thank-you; alternate airy top-down scenes with close editorial crops and avoid repeating the same arrangement.

assets.prompt: Create a square 1:1 premium editorial product-photography scene for a digital planner Etsy listing. Warm ivory stone desk, one elegant landscape tablet centered with a completely blank light screen, soft morning window shadows, a muted amethyst ribbon, a single brass pen and a small dried lavender stem. Refined quiet-luxury stationery styling, generous negative space, realistic materials, gentle depth of field, no readable text, no logos, no interface, no calendar content, no hands, no watermark. Leave the tablet screen clean and flat for a real planner page to be inserted later.
